clue.text: Dirty footballer crossing line

indicators.note: the footballer straddles the line, so the line's letter sits across the middle of the player

parts.note: a back is a defensive player in football

explanation.surface: A footballer who commits a foul by stepping over a line is a dirty player.
explanation.definitionFit: Black hands or a black face are grimy, so black can mean filthy.

clue.text: Boss exploding with fury about driving initially enjoys Rollers?

indicators.note: around, so the shuffled letters go round the single letter
blowing apart, so the letters of the two words are scattered and reassembled
only the first letter of the word is used

explanation.surface: A boss blows up about driving while relaxing in a Rolls-Royce.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rollers' looks like Rolls-Royce cars but means rolling waves; the question mark flags it.
explanation.definitionFit: Riding waves without a board means surfing on breakers, the rollers.

clue.text: Illness after one drops nutrition

indicators.note: the letter for one falls lower in the down entry, moving one place along

parts.note: an ailment is an illness
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Falling ill after one stops eating properly.
explanation.walkthrough: In the down entry the I 'drops' below the L.
explanation.definitionFit: Aliment is food or nourishment, a formal word for sustenance.

clue.text: Don't tell how to prepare a room for a film show?

definitions.meaning: an instruction to keep a secret

definitions.text: how to prepare a room for a film show?
definitions.meaning: for a screening the lights should be off and the room unlit

explanation.surface: Asked to keep a secret about setting up a screening room.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means keep something quiet; literally it means stay without light.

clue.text: Painter also engaged by related blue shade

parts.note: your kin are those related to you
and is a plain synonym of also
sky blue is a shade, and the sky itself is the blue above

explanation.surface: A painter who is also linked by family to a certain shade of blue.
explanation.walkthrough: Wassily Kandinsky was a Russian pioneer of abstract art.
explanation.definitionFit: Kandinsky was a Russian abstract artist, an example of the class named.

clue.text: King currently governed, say, picking up information

parts.note: K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.definitionFit: Knowledge is what is known, the facts and learning gathered.

clue.text: Requirements met, though rising, after intervention of daughter

indicators.note: once the daughter has stepped in between, she sits inside the other word
going up, so in a down entry the word is read bottom to top

parts.note: seen as in seen someone, met them

explanation.surface: Requirements satisfied, though going up, after a daughter steps in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rising' reverses SEEN to NEES; D then goes inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Needs are things required, the necessities.

clue.text: Desire singer to shake tin

indicators.note: to shake off, getting rid of the metal's symbol

parts.note: an informer sings to the police, so a snitch is a singer
Sn is the chemical symbol for tin

explanation.walkthrough: 'singer' is underworld slang for an informer, not a vocalist.
explanation.definitionFit: An itch is a restless craving, as in an itch to travel.

clue.text: Topic about to be covered by 'water and air transport'

parts.note: water transport here, a submarine, sub, travels under water; the following transport applies to both

indicators.note: wrapped up by, so the short abbreviation sits inside the transport words

parts.note: a jet is an aircraft
c, circa, means about

explanation.surface: A discussion point about to be covered under a heading of shipping and aviation.
explanation.definitionFit: A subject is the theme or matter under discussion.

clue.text: Produce that is left in yard

indicators.note: placed inside the abbreviation for yard

parts.note: ie, id est, means that is

explanation.surface: Produce that has been left lying in a yard.
explanation.definitionFit: Yield is what a field or investment produces, the output.

clue.text: Emphasise the return journey?

definitions.meaning: to drive a point home is to stress it forcefully
the trip back after an outing, behind the wheel, heading for your house

explanation.surface: Stressing the importance of the trip back.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means press a point firmly; literally it is motoring back to where you live.

clue.text: Wire and line introduced into most of Scottish tree-trunk

indicators.note: one letter is put inside the shortened trunk
the final letter of the trunk is dropped, leaving most of it

parts.note: a caber is the tree trunk tossed at Highland games

explanation.surface: A wire and a line threaded into part of a Highland games log.
explanation.walkthrough: 'most of' trims CABER to CABE; 'introduced into' then puts L inside it. Tossing the caber is a Scottish Highland games event.
explanation.definitionFit: A cable is a thick insulated wire carrying power or signals.

clue.text: A lot of coins provided by celebrities demanding skills

indicators.note: most but not all, so the last letter of the word for coins goes

parts.note: specie is money in coin form rather than notes
the A-list is the top tier of famous people

explanation.surface: A lot of money paid to celebrities who insist on particular talents.
explanation.walkthrough: Specie means coin money as opposed to notes, an old-fashioned word; the A-list is the top tier of celebrities.
explanation.definitionFit: Specialist work or equipment needs particular expertise to handle, an adjectival use.

clue.text: See 22
Chosen working integrated circuit about right in regard to much IT

indicators.note: the joined pieces go around the abbreviation for right

parts.note: elect means chosen, as in president-elect
on means operating

explanation.surface: A selected, running microchip about right for much computing work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' looks like it means approximately, but here the whole of the first three pieces wraps round the letter for right.
explanation.definitionFit: Much information technology runs on circuits and devices powered by electricity.

clue.text: Assessed one time going through stop light

indicators.note: the two letters pass inside the colour word

parts.note: a red traffic light means stop
a is the indefinite article, meaning one

explanation.surface: A driver assessed for once going through a red light.
explanation.definitionFit: To rate something is to evaluate or grade it, so rated is evaluated.

clue.text: Miss, turning tail in romantic assignations, makes upset

indicators.note: the turned word goes inside the word for romantic meetings

parts.note: dates are romantic meetings

indicators.note: turning round to point the tail first, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: to miss an opportunity is to lose it

explanation.surface: A woman flees from her romantic meetings and leaves someone heartbroken.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning tail' reverses LOSE to ESOL, which goes 'in' DATES. 'Miss' looks like a woman but is a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: Desolates as a verb means devastates or leaves grief-stricken.

clue.text: International group following America in broadcasts set up recovery sites

indicators.note: the alliance pieces go inside the turned word
raised, so in a down entry the word for broadcasts reads bottom to top

parts.note: airs means broadcasts

indicators.note: the alliance comes after the letter for America

parts.note: NATO is an international military alliance

explanation.surface: An international body in American broadcasts establishes places to recover.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set up' turns only the broadcasts word upside down in the down entry, giving SRIA; the American alliance letters then go inside.

clue.text: Political discourse of less interest suggesting alternative to hanging?

parts.note: spin is the slanted presentation politicians give
drier, also spelt dryer, means duller, of less interest

explanation.surface: Duller political rhetoric suggests something other than execution.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hanging' suggests the gallows but means hanging washing out to dry.
explanation.definitionFit: Instead of pegging washing on a line, you can use this appliance.

clue.text: Vegetable, variety of Arab genus

indicators.note: a variety is a different arrangement, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A plant name: a vegetable from a particular Arabian genus.
explanation.definitionFit: The sugar bean is a kind of edible bean, a vegetable.

clue.text: Common classes supported by lecturer

indicators.note: in a down entry, held up by what is placed underneath

parts.note: genera are classes in biology, plural of genus

explanation.surface: Ordinary classes backed by a lecturer.
explanation.definitionFit: General means widespread or shared by most, so ordinary.

clue.text: Company beginning to collect Channel Islands bacteria

indicators.note: only the first letter of the following word is wanted

parts.note: CI is the abbreviation for the Channel Islands, the islands off Normandy such as Jersey

explanation.surface: A firm starting to gather bacteria from the Channel Islands.
explanation.definitionFit: Cocci are spherical bacteria, plural of coccus.

clue.text: Agree artist will depict a fantastical creature

parts.note: to chime with something is to agree with it
RA, Royal Academician, is a standard artist abbreviation

explanation.surface: An artist agrees to paint a mythical beast.
explanation.definitionFit: The Chimera of Greek myth was a fire-breathing hybrid monster.

clue.text: Stupid husband drawn to single person within sight

indicators.note: the two pieces sit inside the word for sight

parts.note: a bead is the front sight of a gun, as in draw a bead on

indicators.note: the husband is attached next to the single person

parts.note: one can mean a single person, as in one never knows

explanation.surface: A foolish husband attracted to a single person he can see.
explanation.walkthrough: BEAD as a gun's sight is a less familiar sense.
explanation.definitionFit: Used attributively, as in a bonehead decision, it means dim-witted.

clue.text: Happen a few trimmed a broom

parts.note: be means occur, happen

indicators.note: cut short, so the final letter is removed

parts.note: some means a few

explanation.surface: It might happen that a few have trimmed a broom.
explanation.definitionFit: A besom is a broom of twigs tied to a handle.

clue.text: Leading criminal very angry about crime securing time in prison

indicators.note: around, so the word for very angry goes round everything else

parts.note: mad means furious

parts.note: sin is a wrongdoing, loosely a crime
a term is a sentence served inside

explanation.surface: A furious reaction to a crime that earns the culprit a prison sentence.
explanation.definitionFit: The planner behind a crime is its chief, the one directing the others.

clue.text: What may be mostly behind burning?

definitions.text: What may be mostly behind burning?

indicators.note: all but the last letter of the word for behind

parts.note: the backside, arse in British slang
on, as a fire or light that is on

explanation.surface: Asking what lies behind a fire.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue reads both as wordplay and as the cause of a blaze: deliberate fire-setting.
explanation.definitionFit: Arson is the crime of deliberately setting fire to property.

clue.text: Accomplished leader dismissed by board

indicators.note: the word for board loses its first letter

parts.note: a table, as in board and lodging

explanation.surface: An able leader is fired by the company's board.
explanation.definitionFit: Able means skilled or capable, so accomplished.

clue.text: Get rid of an area with bushes

definitions.meaning: to cancel or drop a plan
low stunted vegetation or land covered by it

explanation.surface: Clearing away a patch of shrubby land.
explanation.definitionFit: Scrub means cancel informally, and also brushwood or land covered in it.

clue.text: Second attempt secures backer for play unexpectedly

indicators.note: holds inside, so the backer goes within the attempt

parts.note: a try is an attempt
an angel is a financial backer of a theatrical production

explanation.surface: A second go at finding money for a stage show succeeds by surprise.
explanation.definitionFit: Strangely means oddly or surprisingly, in an unforeseen way.

clue.text: Factory back in Newcastle area, active for a long time

indicators.note: read backwards, so the two short pieces are reversed together

parts.note: Newcastle is in North-East England, NE

clue.text: Somewhere to sit down right after tea

parts.note: chai is spiced tea, or tea generally

explanation.surface: Somewhere to take a seat right after a cup of tea.
